access-anonymous: A live HTTPS request to yeoux.net with no cookies, so there is no browser page to record.
share-publish: A publish driven through the HTTP share API in a request context, so there is no browser page to record.
share-delete: A delete driven through the HTTP share API in a request context, so there is no browser page to record.
share-auth: A rejected write driven through the HTTP share API in a request context, so there is no browser page to record.
share-validate: Rejected input driven through the HTTP share API in a request context, so there is no browser page to record.
